clue.text: May job possibly denote water purification?

parts.note: a spring is a source of water
cleaning is a kind of purification

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a seasonal chore might involve treating the water supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'denote' is a link word. 'May job possibly' defines by example: the big annual tidy happens in spring, May being one spring month.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorough annual house tidy traditionally done in spring is a job one might do in May.

clue.text: Avoiding stage production to see home fixtures

parts.note: skirting an issue means avoiding it
the boards is the theatre stage, where productions are put on

explanation.surface: Someone dodges a theatre show in order to inspect household fittings.
explanation.definitionFit: Skirting boards are the strips of wood fitted along the base of interior walls of a house.

clue.text: American lodger accepting unit that's more spacious

indicators.note: the lodger takes in, or accepts, the other piece within it

parts.note: roomer is the American word for a lodger
I is one, a unit

explanation.surface: A lodger from the States agrees to a flat with more space.
explanation.definitionFit: Roomier is a comparative adjective meaning having more room, exactly as more spacious does.

clue.text: Brief report, in every way ostentatious

parts.note: the four compass points north, east, west, south, covering every direction
flash is informal for showy or ostentatious

explanation.surface: A short account that is flashy in every respect.
explanation.definitionFit: A newsflash is a brief bulletin of breaking news, so a short report.

clue.text: Sweets are mostly eaten by animals

indicators.note: the animals swallow the other piece, which ends up inside them

parts.note: camels are animals

indicators.note: most of the word, with its final letter dropped

explanation.surface: Most of the sweets get gobbled up by animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweets' could be read as an adjective, but it is the plural noun defining confections.
explanation.definitionFit: Caramels are chewy toffee sweets made from cooked sugar and butter.

clue.text: Phoney queen was on throne last?

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword queen
a monarch on the throne sat there
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A bogus queen asks whether she was the last to reign.
explanation.definitionFit: Ersatz describes an inferior imitation or substitute, so something fake.

clue.text: In Yucatán a choice snack

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A choice snack found in the Yucatán region of Mexico.
explanation.definitionFit: A nacho is a tortilla chip, a Mexican snack, usually topped with cheese.

clue.text: A Roman leader once more rises and falls

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters are read upwards, so backwards
the leading letter of the word

parts.note: again means once more

explanation.surface: A Roman general climbs back up again and comes crashing down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rises' turns ARAGAIN (A, R from 'Roman leader', AGAIN) upside down in the column.
explanation.definitionFit: Niagara is the famous waterfall on the US-Canada border, so a set of falls.

clue.text: Listen out for mere roundelays

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tunes in to nothing more than simple songs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; a roundelay is a short song with a refrain.
explanation.definitionFit: Mark Antony's famous call in Julius Caesar is a plea for the crowd to pay attention, i.e. hear me.

clue.text: Actor getting employment in industrial plant

indicators.note: the actor gets, or takes in, the other piece

parts.note: Jeremy Irons is an English actor
work means employment

explanation.surface: A performer lands a job in a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: An ironworks is a factory where iron is smelted or made into goods.

clue.text: Notorious twins, we hear, in Vogue

indicators.note: signals a word that sounds like another when spoken

parts.note: the Krays were notorious London gangster twins of the 1960s

explanation.surface: Infamous twins are featured in a fashion magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word. 'Vogue' looks like the magazine, but it means a fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze is a fad, something briefly in fashion, as a vogue is.

clue.text: One who takes last place in list started by tinker?

definitions.text: last place in list started by tinker?
definitions.meaning: the counting rhyme Tinker, tailor, soldier, sailor, rich man, poor man, beggar man ends on this figure

explanation.surface: Someone takes the bottom spot on a list begun by a tinker.
explanation.walkthrough: The rhyme is a traditional counting game children recite, for instance over cherry stones.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief steals, taking things, and comes last in the old counting rhyme.

clue.text: Opera house chap that was lauded by Betjeman?

parts.note: the Met is the Metropolitan Opera house in New York
Roland is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man from an opera house was praised by the poet Betjeman.
explanation.walkthrough: John Betjeman, Poet Laureate, celebrated the London suburbs along the Metropolitan Railway in his 1973 film.
explanation.definitionFit: Metroland, the suburbs served by London's Metropolitan line, was the subject of Betjeman's affectionate documentary.

clue.text: As a rule, no marines join forces

parts.note: RM is the Royal Marines
to ally is to join forces

explanation.surface: Usually marines decline to team up with others.
explanation.definitionFit: Normally means usually or ordinarily, the same as as a rule.

clue.text: Fix bark

definitions.meaning: to graze the skin, as when barking a shin

explanation.definitionFit: A scrape is a fix or awkward situation; to scrape a knee is to bark it.

clue.text: Tea for two — and one more dance

indicators.note: the tea is served twice, one for each of two

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
one more tea, another cha

explanation.surface: A tea for two, then a third cup, and a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link word; 'Tea for Two' is also a famous song, adding to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The cha-cha-cha is a Latin ballroom dance of Cuban origin.

clue.text: Possibly a musical box put on display?

parts.note: a show is a musical stage production
a case is a box

explanation.surface: A musical box might be shown off to visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly a' is a link phrase; 'musical box' looks like a single item but splits in two.
explanation.definitionFit: To showcase something is to present it prominently, putting it on display.

clue.text: Smart sailor's last seen in bay

indicators.note: the letter appears inside the bay

parts.note: a bight is a curving bay

indicators.note: the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A smart sailor was last spotted in the bay.
explanation.definitionFit: Bright means clever or quick-witted, as smart does.

clue.text: Deep topic for grammarians, one noun primarily

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: primarily means first, so the opening letter

parts.note: tense is a grammatical category that grammarians study

explanation.surface: A profound subject for grammar teachers: one noun first.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense feeling is deep or profound feeling.

clue.text: Having time to cure — a doctor's mission remembered

parts.note: to heal is to cure
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor with time to treat patients on a remembered mission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having' is a link word. 'Remember the Alamo' was the Texan battle cry after the 1836 siege.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo was a Spanish mission in Texas, famously remembered in the slogan of the Texas Revolution.

clue.text: Clothes from a shopping centre are left behind

indicators.note: behind places the letter after the rest
centre picks the middle letters of the word

parts.note: L is left

explanation.surface: Clothes bought at a shopping centre were left behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a link word; 'shopping centre' is not a mall but the middle pair of SHOPPING.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparel is a formal word for clothing.

clue.text: Domesticated animal on mountain — a Manx cat?

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed beneath, so the mountain comes first

parts.note: an alp is a mountain

indicators.note: a Manx cat has no tail, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before losing its tail

explanation.surface: A tame creature on a mountain is asked whether it is a tailless cat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' puts the mountain on top in this down entry. A Manx cat is a breed from the Isle of Man with no tail, hence the clipped word.
explanation.definitionFit: The alpaca is a South American camelid, a llama relative, domesticated for its wool.

clue.text: RAF get confused with owl that may be seen when the sun has set

definitions.text: that may be seen when the sun has set

indicators.note: the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Air force personnel are befuddled by an owl spotted after sunset.
explanation.definitionFit: An afterglow is the light lingering in the sky after sunset.

clue.text: Dance tune that's peculiar with band half cut

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or peculiar

indicators.note: half the word is cut away, leaving its first half

explanation.surface: A strange tune played by a band that has lost half its members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' and 'with' are link words; 'half cut' also means drunk, chiming with rum.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban dance, and also the music played for it.

clue.text: Overstimulated spin doctor?

definitions.meaning: jokily, someone who hypes things up, a publicist

explanation.definitionFit: Hyper means overexcited; whimsically, one who hypes is a spin doctor.

clue.text: Material used for garden implements

indicators.note: the letters are taken from, used for building, the words that follow

explanation.surface: Fabric used to make garden tools.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is a hard-wearing cotton twill fabric used for jeans.

clue.text: Pine for another setter

definitions.meaning: the monkey puzzle tree, a South American conifer
the pseudonym of the celebrated Guardian setter John Graham

explanation.surface: A setter pines for a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; this puzzle's own setter is Orlando, hence 'another'.
explanation.definitionFit: Araucaria is the genus of the monkey puzzle pine, and the alias of a famous Guardian compiler.

clue.text: A play put forward for discussion, with parts given out

parts.note: separate as a verb means to divide into parts and distribute them
to table a motion is to put it forward for discussion

explanation.surface: A drama is proposed for debate, and the roles are handed out.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in the opposite order from the clue. Separate Tables is a Terence Rattigan play.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate Tables is a 1954 pair of one-act plays by Terence Rattigan.
